owners.reason: BullMQ job state cannot expire (evicting or expiring it loses the job). Bounded per queue by removeOnComplete (last 1,000, 1 h) and removeOnFail (last 500, 3 days); the event stream is trimmed by BullMQ at 10,000 entries (maxEvents default, bullmq 6.3.12).
One sorted-set member per worker process; every beat removes members older than twice the alive window (zremrangebyscore) and a clean stop removes its own.
